name: CEPF Madagascar and the Indian Ocean Islands Biodiversity Hotspot grants

administered_by.name: IUCN NL with SAF/FJKM, ID, FORENA and SeyCCAT

summary: CEPF grants for civil society organisations conserving biodiversity in Madagascar, Comoros, Mauritius and Seychelles; the most recent call funded large grants to conserve threatened tree species in Madagascar.

geography.label: Madagascar and the Indian Ocean Islands

reporting: Grantees submit baseline monitoring tools within three months; large-grant holders file quarterly financial reports and six-monthly progress reports, small-grant reporting is set in the grant agreement, and every grant ends with a final completion and impact report within two months.

calls.label: Call for letters of inquiry, large grants for threatened trees in Madagascar (May 2026)

deadline.text: Tuesday 7 July 2026 - 11:59 p.m. (Eastern Standard Time Zone, Washington, D.C, USA)

status.quote: Madagascar and the Indian Ocean Islands Call for Letters of Inquiry for Large Grants Closed Tuesday, July 7, 2026.

deadline.quote: Closing Date: Tuesday 7 July 2026 - 11:59 p.m. (Eastern Standard Time Zone, Washington, D.C, USA)

administered_by.quote: Regional Implementation Team (RIT) IUCN NL, SAF/FJKM (Madagascar), ID (Comoros), FORENA (Mauritius) and SeyCCAT (Seychelles)

applicant_types.quote: The Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund invites non-governmental organizations, community groups, private companies, universities, and other civil society organizations (CSOs) to submit proposals

geography.quote: Eligible Countries Comoros, Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles

access.quote: Applicants are invited to submit their LOI online via the ConservationGrants portal in French or English.

window.quote: Applications submitted after the deadline will not be accepted whatever the reason.

amount.quote: Grant Size: between US$ 50,000 and US$ 200,000

reporting.quote: Recipients of large grants must submit financial reports each quarter and progress reports every six months through ConservationGrants.
